capabilities: Render infographics from infographic fenced code blocks
Write configurations in JSON or AntV's declarative DSL
Pick from 200+ built-in templates (timelines, hierarchies, charts, comparisons)
Export rendered blocks as SVG or PNG and keep Export to PDF compatible
Resize blocks by dragging handles and set width or alignment via fence parameters
extras: Also distributed as an Agent Skill so AI agents can generate infographic code blocks; installable via BRAT for beta versions; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render structured infographics like timelines, hierarchies, and comparisons from code blocks; Mermaid covers diagrams but not these infographic layouts.

relations.evidence: Render AntV Infographic visualizations directly in your Obsidian notes using fenced code blocks.

summary: Renders AntV Infographic visualizations from fenced code blocks in notes, with 200+ templates, JSON or DSL syntax, and SVG/PNG export.
